Step12PaymentMethod_100559849_185549445.description: Payment method selection shown when fees apply. The user can pay online using secure credit card processing, mail in a cheque or money order with the remittance form, or pay in person at a FrontCounter BC office. Credit card options include Visa, Visa Debit, MasterCard, Debit MasterCard, and American Express. Cheques or money orders must be payable to the Minister of Finance.
